name: django-postgres
title: Django 5 + Postgres + Docker (Fly.io / Railway / Render)
summary: Python web app or JSON API: Django 5.x (Django REST Framework or Django Ninja for APIs), Django ORM with per-app migrations, Postgres over psycopg 3, pytest + pytest-django, ruff for lint and format, pyright (or mypy) with django-stubs, uv for dependencies, one Docker image served by gunicorn (uvicorn only for ASGI) on Fly.io, Railway, or Render, GitHub Actions CI with a CI-gated deploy.
recommended_for: a data-heavy product where the admin, the ORM, and a mature auth and permissions system are worth more than a JavaScript-first stack, or a Python team that wants one deployable image and a boring rollback
not_for: single-page apps with a thin backend, high-fan-out async or streaming workloads (FastAPI or Go), data pipelines, or teams already committed to another framework

commands.migrate_prod: <scripts/migrate-prod.sh: verifies DATABASE_URL host, runs showmigrations --plan, demands typed confirmation, then migrate>
commands.deploy: git push origin main (CI-gated image build and platform deploy; see WORKFLOW.md)

format_cmd: uv run ruff format . (ruff also replaces isort via the I rule set)
migration_tool: Django migrations (per-app numbered files resolved as a dependency graph, applied state in the django_migrations table; no timestamp watermark, conflicts surface as multiple leaf nodes)
date_helpers: <core/dates.py> (format_date, format_calendar_date, today_local_iso); django.utils.timezone.now() for timestamps, never datetime.now()
app_verifier_boot: uv run python manage.py migrate && uv run python manage.py runserver (dev server on :8000), then drive the changed URLs with the Django test client, curl, or Playwright

overlay.rules: rules/*.md replace the core api-boundary/data-layer/services/scripts rules; the core ui.md stays (templates and forms are not stack-specific enough to override)
overlay.qa_pack: none; a deterministic sweep is a pytest -m e2e job (Playwright for Python) against a staging app, written once a staging target exists
